gloss: group leader; squad leader; team leader

definitions.gloss: group leader; squad leader; team leader
definitions.explanation: The leader of a small group or squad, used in schools, workplaces, the military, and neighborhood associations. A position of responsibility within a larger organization.

examples.japanese: {班長|はんちょう}を{決|き}める。
{今月|こんげつ}の{班長|はんちょう}は{田中|たなか}さんです。
examples.english: This month's group leader is Tanaka-san.

examples.japanese: {班長|はんちょう}として{班員|はんいん}の{出欠|しゅっけつ}を{確認|かくにん}する{役割|やくわり}がある。
examples.english: As group leader, I have the role of checking attendance of the group members.

notes: Common in school settings where students are divided into {班|はん} (groups) for activities like lunch, cleaning, or class projects. The {班長|はんちょう} rotates among group members. Also used in {町内会|ちょうないかい} (neighborhood associations) where the {班長|はんちょう} handles communication and dues collection. In military contexts, refers to a squad leader. Compare with {組長|くみちょう} (class leader in schools; also gang boss) and {委員長|いいんちょう} (committee chairperson).
